description: Exploit, a time-neutral averaging booster in the direction opposite to E025 (which pulled harder and hurt by 0.27 pp held-out). D003 (C0024/C0025) points to the reset interval as the untuned Lookahead knob. On the E027 tip, change only the Lookahead update interval from every 5 to every 10 steps. Rescale the per-update retention so the total pull per step is unchanged (alpha_10 = alpha_5**2 at each ramp point, same exponent 3), and keep the final full copy. LR, epochs, resolution, wd and LS stay unchanged. Recapture the step graphs if the interval or alpha is baked in, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2.
